q: Plants lack a _______ system like animals. (2025- Set 10)
e: Plants lack a nervous system to coordinate responses like animals do.

q: The _______ stimuli to which plants respond to abiotic or biotic stress. (2025- Set 5)
e: Plants respond to environmental stimuli triggered by abiotic or biotic stress.

q: The cells of _______ are isodiametric, thin wall, and consist of large nucleus and dense cytoplasm. (2025- Set 8)
e: Meristematic cells are thin-walled, isodiametric, and contain a large nucleus with dense cytoplasm.

q: During development, structures and functions of organs or cells are _______. (2025- Set 2)
e: Development involves structural and functional changes in cells and organs.

q: The process of development occurs in an ordered fashion within a single diploid cell called _______. (2024-Set 3)
e: Organism development begins in an orderly manner from a single diploid zygote.

q: Gibberellins are plant hormones that include _______. (2026- Set 1)
e: Gibberellins are a group of plant hormones that include gibberellic acid.

q: A plant hormone is an _______ compound. (2025- Set 3)
e: Plant hormones are naturally occurring organic chemical compounds.

q: _______ is an example in the group of hormones that promote dormancy in plants. (2025- Set 7)
e: Abscisic acid functions as an inhibitor that promotes dormancy in seeds and buds.

q: _______ stimulates ripening of fruits. (2025- Set 12)
e: Ethylene is the primary gaseous plant hormone responsible for fruit ripening.

q: Phytohormones are essential _______ compounds required in very small quantities. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Phytohormones are organic compounds needed in trace amounts to regulate plant growth.

q: Coconut milk is a rich source of _______. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းနှင့်ပြည်နယ်အချို့တွင်မေး) (2025-Set 11)
e: Coconut milk liquid endosperm contains high levels of cytokinins.

q: The only gaseous phytohormone is _______. (2024-Set 2)
e: Ethylene is the sole plant growth regulator that exists as a gas.

q: The dormancy of seeds can be broken by _______. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Seed dormancy can be overcome through scarification, stratification, or treatment with hormones.

q: The vivipary germination is found in _______. (2025-Set 1)
e: Vivipary germination occurs in plants such as agave.

q: Effect or requirements of relative length of day and night on flowering is called _______. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Photoperiodism is the physiological response of plants to relative day and night duration.

q: Flowering hormone is suggested to be _______. (2025- Set 4)
e: Florigen is the hypothetical hormone responsible for initiating flowering.

q: Phytochrome, cryptochrome and phototropin are called _______. (2025- Set 6)
e: Phytochrome, cryptochrome, and phototropin are photoreceptor proteins in plants.

q: _______ causes a variety of responses in the plant body in addition to photosynthesis. (2024-Set 4)
e: Light serves as an environmental cue triggering photomorphogenic responses beyond photosynthesis.

q: The central nervous system is composed of the brain and _______. (2025- Set 13)
e: The central nervous system (CNS) consists of the brain and spinal cord.

q: The hindbrain consists of the _______, pons and medulla oblongata. (2025- Set 6)
e: The hindbrain comprises the cerebellum, pons, and medulla oblongata.

q: The skull forms a protective bony armour around the _______. (2025- Set 10)
e: The bony cranium of the skull encloses and protects the brain.

q: The largest part of the brain is _______. (2024-Set 2/2025-Set7)
e: The cerebrum is the largest and most prominent part of the brain.

q: The pons is located above and in front of the _______ in the brainstem. (2024-Set 4)
e: The pons lies superior to the medulla oblongata within the brainstem structure.

q: The midbrain is located above the _______ in the brainstem. (2025- Set 5)
e: The midbrain is situated above the pons in the brainstem.

q: The brain can be subdivided into _______ general regions. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: The brain is divided into three major regions: forebrain, midbrain, and hindbrain.

q: The parasympathetic system uses the neurotransmitter _______ to control organ responses. (2024-Set 3)
e: Acetylcholine is the key neurotransmitter used by parasympathetic postganglionic fibers.

q: Injury to the spinal column can also damage the _______. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Damage to the vertebral spinal column can directly injure the encased spinal cord.

q: The nervous system is composed of only _______ main type of cells. (2026- Set 2)
e: The nervous system consists of two main cell types: neurones and glial cells.

q: The activity of neurones is supported by another type of cells called _______. (2026- Set 1)
e: Glial cells provide essential structural and metabolic support to neurones.

q: The activity of _______ is supported by another type of cells called glial cells. (2025- Set 9)
e: Neurones rely on glial cells for protection and nutritional support.

q: _______ neurones transmit impulses from the sensory receptors to the central nervous system. (2025- Set 2)
e: Sensory neurones carry nerve impulses from sensory receptors toward the CNS.

q: Multipolar neurone found in the _______ and spinal cord. (2025- Set 3)
e: Multipolar neurones are located in the brain and spinal cord.

q: Inadequate production of _______ is linked to Alzheimer's disease. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Deficiencies in key neurotransmitters like dopamine are implicated in neurodegenerative diseases.

q: A neuromuscular junction is a synapse between a motor neurone and a _______ cell. (2025- Set 1)
e: The neuromuscular junction forms the synaptic connection between a motor neurone and a muscle cell.

q: The middle coat of the eyeball is _______. (2025- Set 4,13)
e: The choroid is the vascular middle layer of the eyeball.

q: The endocrine glands and their hormones make up the _______. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းနှင့်ပြည်နယ်အချို့တွင်မေး)
e: The endocrine system consists of endocrine glands and the hormones they secrete.

q: _______ hormone is produced by the thyroid gland. (2025- Set 11)
e: Calcitonin is a hormone synthesized and secreted by the thyroid gland.

q: _______ hormone promotes sperm formation. (2025- Set 12)
e: Testosterone stimulates spermatogenesis in males.

q: _______ hormone promotes sperm formation and development of the male sexual characteristics. (2025- Set 8)
e: Testosterone promotes sperm production as well as primary and secondary male sexual characteristics.
